authority: Execution record and source comparison; no new law or promotion

PDPE.text: PROPOSE reads the current committed snapshot and emits every completing lift for the declared base move.
PDPE.consequence: The requested keep-one and keep-two constant assignments can be enumerated and receipted. Their correspondence to this clause's offered lifts/readings remains MAYBE; enumerating the diagnostic family does not discharge that correspondence. No proof over the power set is requested.

PDPE.text: DECIDE receives the proposed completion relation and a governed input. It may select only a proposed lift. DECIDE does not create a lift.
PDPE.consequence: Strict discharge is computed without a person or scalar choice. A unique strict member is witnessed on the tested family; equality of that family with the promoted offer relation is a separate premise.

PDPE.text: PROMOTE binds the selected lift to source committed state, WHENCE, agreement-change receipt, previous promoted-continuity link, successor identity.
PDPE.consequence: Tick-level promotion is in the law; no personal per-tick DECIDE is requested. Its operand must be a member supplied by the preceding law-bound stages.

PDPE.text: EXECUTE commits only the exact promoted successor extending the current continuity head. unpromoted successor := NO
PDPE.consequence: No link is appended from a diagnostic-only assignment. Existing J17 admission and links remain untouched.

typed_distinction.producer_member: LIFT(from,via,to); writes FROM to NO and TO to THIS; retains every other flag

typed_distinction.comparison: NOT_SAME operations: the located lift producer writes at most two flag coordinates, while the strict J17 fibre assignment changes twelve. A7's reference to readings does not itself instantiate this multi-flag action.
typed_distinction.E10: Erratum 63 types rotations about domain, triad and corridor. A constant fibre overwrite is not the same operation as that rotation.
